_comment: Jackson MS v3 — the coverage-first (source-led) methodology applied to the Jackson MSA. NOT a workbook: the grid at metro-research/jackson-v3/tabs.json was authored directly in the shape workbook-extract.mjs reads via --raw, so no Sheet exists. Separate config and separate batch tag from scripts/metros/jackson.json, on the lancaster-v3 precedent: the 2026-07-31 import stays immutable and this carries its own one-statement rollback handle. Same metro_area, so the public URL /courts/in/jackson is unchanged. NOT YET IMPORTED — read-only projection only.
_envelope_comment: Copied verbatim from scripts/metros/jackson.json, which derived it 2026-07-31 from the Jackson, MS MSA COUNTY LIST (Hinds, Madison, Rankin, Copiah, Simpson, Yazoo, Holmes) rather than from an observed bounding box. Same metro, same county list, so re-deriving it would be a chance to introduce a difference and no chance to improve one. It is load-bearing for this batch in a way it was not for the last one: v3 reaches into Simpson County for the first time (Magee 31.87/-89.73 and Mendenhall 31.96/-89.87), and both sit inside this envelope but OUTSIDE the observed bbox of the 2026-07-31 venues (lat 32.2544..32.4675). An envelope cut to the observed bbox would have rejected two legitimate venues — which is precisely the failure mode the MSA-derived rule exists to prevent.
msa: Jackson, MS (Hinds, Madison, Rankin, Copiah, Simpson, Yazoo, Holmes counties)
_expected_count_comment: POST-EXCLUSION count, matching the lancaster-v3 precedent (35 researched - 8 excluded = 27 there; 23 researched - 12 excluded = 11 here). It is the number of venues this batch actually imports, not the number the artifact carries.
_exclude_comment: TWELVE venues are researched and present in the artifact but held OUT of this run because a live listing from jackson-2026-07-31 already represents them. Excluding is strictly safer than importing: it leaves each pre-existing row byte-for-byte untouched and keeps this batch a clean INSERT against a disjoint slug set, so `update facility_listings set status='draft' where source='jackson-v3-2026-08-05'` reverses the whole thing without touching a published URL. All twelve collide on slug and would abort preflight anyway. The reconcile mechanism is NOT usable on any of them: reconciles[] mandates osm_id and asserts exactly one live row carries it, and all twelve jackson-2026-07-31 listings have osm_id = NULL. Improving an existing row is therefore a separate, gated, keyed-UPDATE slice — see the Towne Park note below.

live PUBLISHED row shiloh-park-pickleball-courts-brandon-ms, already high-precision. This pass resolved the directories' Shiloh Park / Shiloh Splash Park split as ONE site rather than two, which confirms the live row rather than changing it.

live DRAFT row towne-park-pickleball-complex-clinton-ms, held only on a low-precision coordinate that ADR-16 now releases. THIS PASS FOUND A GENUINE CORRECTION the live row does not have: the address is 915 Old Vicksburg Road (City of Clinton's own park-improvements pages), not the 853 Old Vicksburg Road the live row carries — which is why it geocoded low. Applying it is a keyed UPDATE on an existing row and belongs to its own gated slice, not to an import (the lancaster-v3 bright-side-opportunities-center precedent).

live DRAFT row ridgeland-tennis-center-and-pickleball-courts-ridgeland-ms, held only on a low-precision coordinate that ADR-16 now releases — a candidate for a publish run on the OLD batch rather than a re-import here.
live DRAFT row the-club-at-the-township-ridgeland-ms, same ADR-16 situation as ridgeland-tennis-center.
live DRAFT row madison-methodist-church-madison-ms, same ADR-16 situation.

live DRAFT row magnolia-pickleball-gluckstadt-ms, held on NO coordinate. This pass confirms the address (547 Church Rd Suite G) against the operator's own site, so the hold is a geocoding problem rather than a research one; re-geocoding the live row is the fix, not a re-import.
live DRAFT row clinton-pickleball-club-at-cascades-clinton-ms, held on NO coordinate. The Clinton Chamber directory independently confirms 60 Cascades West; same situation as magnolia-pickleball.

_stage_2b_note: Stage 2b (union against the database) was run and came back CLEAN, which is worth recording because Lancaster's did not. A query over facility_listings for every MSA city plus metro_area='Jackson' returned exactly the 12 rows of jackson-2026-07-31 — no orphan OSM drafts, no rows filed under a different metro_area, nothing the source-led pass missed that the venue-led pass had found. All 12 appear in this artifact. Source-led beat venue-led here without the non-superset problem Lancaster hit (Denver Recreation Center).
_deliberate_exclusions_note: FOUR leads were researched and deliberately kept OUT of the artifact entirely, each for a reason worth recording so a later pass does not re-litigate them. (1) THE COURTHOUSE / Courthouse Racquet & Fitness, 46 Northtown Drive, Jackson — marketed as '54 to 60 pickleball courts' on courthousepickleball.com and courthousems.com, but the Yelp entries for both the Jackson and Madison Courthouse Racquet & Fitness locations read CLOSED, USTA Mississippi lists 'Courthouse Tennis & Fitness Club For Sale', and ProVisions LLC markets the building with an offering memorandum and floor plans. Those sites are SALES COLLATERAL describing what a buyer could operate, not a facilities record of what is open. Not a venue today. (2) LEFLEUR'S BLUFF STATE PARK, Jackson — pickleball appears in the LeFleur's Bluff Conservancy master plan with $13M appropriated in the 2026 legislative session; it is funded and planned, NOT built. Future tense. (3) OLD TRACE PARK / Ridgeland Recreation Center, 137 Old Trace Park — the pickleball claim is aggregator-only; the City of Ridgeland's own page describes the building as a senior-activities lodge not available for rent and lists no courts. (4) BYRAM MUNICIPAL SPORTS COMPLEX, 5901 Terry Road — the city's own page labels it 'Proposed'. Also checked and excluded on aggregator-only evidence: Clinton Bark Park (no local source names pickleball; most likely a mis-filing of the Towne Park complex, which had 4 courts before its expansion to 8), Clinton Branch YMCA and Flowood Branch YMCA (metroymcams.org is silent on pickleball for all three branches), and Baptist Healthplex-Jackson at 717 Manship St (baptistonline.org lists the amenities and pickleball is not among them — unlike the Clinton Healthplex, whose own site does list it and which IS included).
_coverage_note: Jackson's outer counties are genuinely thin, and that is a finding rather than a shortfall. Copiah (Hazlehurst, Crystal Springs, Wesson), Yazoo (Yazoo City) and Holmes (Lexington, Durant, Goodman) returned NO pickleball venue against any source — municipal, tourism, local news or directory. Simpson County produced two, both from the county newspaper. Canton, the Madison County seat, returned none: every 'Canton Parks & Recreation pickleball' result belongs to Canton OHIO (cantonparksandrec.com, the 'Hall of Fame City' club), Canton CT, Canton IL, Canton MI or Canton MA. That wrong-state contamination is the single most dangerous false positive this pass encountered and is recorded here so the next pass recognizes it immediately.
_expected_publish_comment: DELIBERATELY ABSENT until the owner has read the --stage=project projection. Both --stage=project and --stage=publish assert against this block and fail the run on any divergence, and reportExpected says in as many words 'Fix the pipeline. Do NOT edit the expectation to match the output.' Authoring it before the projection would make it a guess to be corrected; authoring it after, from a reviewed list, makes it the per-metro deliberate-release mechanism ADR-17 intends. Populate from the owner's locked decision, then re-run project.
